description: Cast a verification or quality vote on a lead: useful, junk (spam, course, ad, not work), scam (fraud, upfront fee, illegal), or closed (already expired or taken). Requires user token. Safety-ladder: the first call returns status "held" with a confirmation_token; the vote is recorded only on a repeat call with identical arguments plus confirm:true and that token.

confirm.description: Set true (with confirmation_token) to execute a previously held vote after the user approves

confirmation_token.description: The token returned by the held first call

name: vote_lead
